title: I’ve been having Mallworld dreams more often lately…
content: I was back at the actual Mall this time. I couldn’t find my way out. I wasn’t walking fast enough so I started kinda sliding across the floor on my knees at a high rate of speed. Imagine ice skating but on my knees but super fast. I followed some people into a store where there was a Victorian couple gathered around a coffin with their child in it, only the child wasn’t dead. The child pointed to a wall that was a secret passage. It led to a theater where everyone looked familiar to me. It ranged from family, old friends to people that I may have only met a couple times. Everyone was taking their seats but there wasn’t a show or anything. I leave the theater and find myself at my old middle school. But in my head I’m in high school. I don’t know where I’m going but I feel late for a class. I wander around until a bell rings for lunch. I get in line for food but every line I’m in has run out of food. Nobody looks familiar at this school at all. I go to the rest room. And it’s the disgusting weird restroom that we’re all familiar with. Every stall is either occupied or just too disgusting to use. I finally find a stall thats kind of clean but there’s 2 toilets facing each other someone is using one of them. Weird. I just end up walking out and head to my car in the parking lot. It takes me forever to find because all the cars look the same. I get in the car and start driving. I get on the freeway and go up a very high bridge. I start going downhill off this bridge but my brakes don’t work and the road leads straight into the ocean. I sink. I’m about to drown and I wake up. I’ve had various versions of this dream many times. Sometimes a cruise ship is involved. Sometimes there’s a casino that lets me roll huge dice at craps. All I know is it’s weird as fuck. And so many people have similar dreams like this. I often wonder what Mallworld was like before malls. Was there a similar dream place that our ancestors would dream of? Is it exclusive to us GATE kids? Sooooo many questions
